lines.text: Many learners say: Many peoples came to the party.

en.tip: People is already plural. Say “Many people came”.
en.caption: Do you say “Many peoples came to the party”? 😅 People is already plural, so you do not add an s. “Many people came to the party” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
